name: POST /api/leadflow/identity/candidates/:link_id/decision - record a steward's verdict on a possible-same match
description:
The three decisions the Identity Candidate Review modal offers: verify_link, keep_separate, defer.

VERIFY LINK DOES NOT COLLAPSE THE RECORDS, and the upstream naming actively suggests it does. `verify_link` maps to sdk-identity-resolver's `approve`, which calls mergeRecords - and mergeRecords ONLY inserts a row into empi.merge_event and flips the candidate's status. Neither person row is deleted or rewritten, and both ids survive INSIDE the event. That is precisely what makes the decision reversible: unmerge emits a compensating event against the merge_id. A steward reading a button wired to something called 'merge' would reasonably assume the second record is absorbed, so the response states both_records_retained explicitly rather than leaving it to be inferred from an absence.

THE REVERSIBILITY REFERENCE IS RETURNED, NOT INFERRED. `reversibility_ref` is the merge_id that POST /api/empi/merges/:merge_id/unmerge takes. It is null on keep_separate, because a rejection creates no merge event and there is nothing to reverse - null here means 'nothing to undo', never 'we lost the reference'.

A REASON IS REQUIRED FOR EVERY RECORDED DECISION. The steward is asserting that two records are or are not the same person, against a model that already declined to decide. Why they concluded it is the only part a later reader - or the person wrongly linked - can actually assess. Defer alone needs no reason, because deferring asserts nothing.

DEFER WRITES NOTHING UPSTREAM and answers recorded:false. Deferring is declining to decide; recording it would take the case out of the queue on the strength of a steward saying 'not now', and the case would stop being anyone's problem.

REFUSES RATHER THAN FAKES WHEN NO APPROVAL ROUTE IS CONFIGURED. A decision needs a step id, a step id needs an enqueued review, and an enqueued review needs a route_id that this deployment has no value for. So it answers 503 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE naming the missing setting. An UNRECORDED decision is worse than a blocked one: the case leaves the steward's queue believing it settled, with no reversibility reference to undo it by. 503 rather than 500 because nothing is broken - a prerequisite is absent.

requiresRole:["data_steward"] and NO testCase pins an Authorization header (MUST-71). identity.merge_review is held by the Data Steward alone; the suite's default identity bridges to sales_rep and would only see 403, so the runner swaps to testCredentials.data_steward.

THE HAPPY PATH IS DEFER, and that is a real decision rather than a workaround for an environment. It is the one branch that is complete in itself - it touches no upstream service by design, so it exercises the route, the policy gate, the validator and the response contract without depending on an approval route this deployment does not have. The recorded branches are held by the 503 case, which is the honest observation here. CAPTURES reversibility_ref SO A RETRACTION CAN CHAIN FROM THE DECISION THAT CREATED IT. That is the only id this endpoint creates: the merge_id that POST /links/:merge_id/retract takes. It is deliberately NULLABLE and the capture will be empty on two of the three verdicts - keep_separate creates no merge event, and defer creates nothing at all - so a dependent must chain from a recorded verify_link, which needs an approval route this deployment does not have. Declared anyway rather than omitted, because the producer/consumer link is real and MUST-14 exists so the next author does not invent a key for it. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Defer leaves the case open and records nothing upstream
NEGATIVE: an unrecognised decision is rejected
NEGATIVE: a recorded decision without a reason is refused
NEGATIVE: with no approval route the decision is refused, not silently dropped

payload.reason: normalised mobile and property both match exactly

errorCases.message: decision must be one of verify_link, keep_separate, defer
errorCases.when: the decision is absent or not one of the three the modal offers.

errorCases.message: reason is required for a recorded decision
errorCases.when: verify_link or keep_separate is sent with no reason. Defer is exempt because it asserts nothing.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent or not Bearer. Not authored as a testCase: pinning a header would defeat the role swap (MUST-71).

errorCases.message: No policy grants this action to the caller's roles.
errorCases.when: the caller does not hold identity.merge_review. NOT reachable while this runs under requiresRole, and kept because it is the branch the default suite identity receives.

errorCases.message: No steward approval route is configured, so this decision cannot be recorded or reversed.
errorCases.when: PROJEXCLOUD_STEWARD_ROUTE_ID is unset, or the route produces no pending step. Refusing is deliberate: an unrecorded decision takes the case out of the queue with no reversibility reference.
